foes_note: Each new foe with 999 HP and attacks off; the script strikes the longest word it finds (up to three times), Quills the first consonant and ends the turn. trail = [words, your hp, foe hp, foe block before its turn, the trick in force on the next turn, the next hand (* crossed, first letter of an enchantment), the next blade squares joined].
hits_note: wordHit on fixed words from the first slot (2nd tile on fire, edge Haiku, no runes) under each foe trick: [trick, word, blade squares, words already struck this turn, last length, damage, block it gains, damage bounced back].
tricks_note: Every trick in the lab kit used once in kit order on the first tile (pair, or 3-letter word) that takes it, for two turns: [trick, hand (^ fire, # steel, $ gold, + leaf, * crossed), foe hp, block, hp].
sword_note: Sword days with preset runes; the word goes in at slot (turn mod 4). trail = [word, foe index, your hp, your block, foe hps, letters back from the bag] after each turn.
deep_note: Endless descent, scripted the same way with foe attacks off and foe HP x0.5 so it goes deep; trail is [word, foe index, foe hp]. deep_foes = deepFoe(3,4,5,6,9) at the normal HP scale.
